Kane Desert is coyote from year [ERROR]. 
ERROR: Year can not be defined because object is temporal [ERROR].

He doesn't know how he appears in space on the time travel station named [ERROR].

Accidentally, he teleports to year 3001. And he has no way back. He must escape this place to find out who he is. However, people around him is not good. He can't trust no one as they only pretend to be caring about him.

凯恩·沙漠 (Kane Desert) 是[ERROR]年的土狼。
错误：无法定义年份，因为对象是时间[ERROR]。

他不知道自己是怎么出现在太空中的，名为[ERROR]的时空旅行站上的。

一不小心，他传送到了3​​001年，而且已经没有回去的路了。他必须逃离这个地方，找出他是谁。然而，他身边的人却并不好。他无法相信任何人，因为他们只是假装关心他。
